sections.h2: What Is Teknoppy's React JS Process and Timeline?
sections.intro: Every project follows five stages, each with a set time frame.

items.title: UX and interface design (1 to 2 weeks)

items.text: You see a working demo at the end of each sprint.

items.title: Testing and launch (1 to 2 weeks)

items.title: Maintenance and support (ongoing)
items.text: React js maintenance and support Kochi clients choose covers updates, bug fixes, security patches and small improvements on a monthly plan.

paragraphs.text: Typical totals: 4 to 6 weeks for a small single page app, 8 to 12 weeks for a mid-size application, and 3 to 6 months for a large platform.

sections.h2: Can You Migrate an Older Website or App to React?

paragraphs.text: Our React JS migration services Kerala companies use move these systems to React in stages, so your business keeps running during the switch.

A common project is jQuery to React migration. We rebuild the busiest screens first, connect them to your existing backend, and retire old code step by step. You get a written migration plan with a timeline for each stage.

sections.h2: React JS vs Angular for Business Apps: Which Should You Choose?

paragraphs.html: Clients often ask us to compare React JS vs Angular for business apps. Both are proven, well-supported tools, and the right choice depends on your project.

paragraphs.text: React is a library focused on the user interface. It is flexible, has a very large hiring pool, and suits products that change often. In the 2025 Stack Overflow Developer Survey, about 45% of developers reported using React, second only to Node.js.
Angular is a full framework with more built-in rules, suited to large teams that want one fixed structure. If your developers already use Angular, we will say so honestly rather than push a rewrite.

sections.h2: How Much Does React JS Development Cost in India?

paragraphs.text: Cost depends on the number of screens, user roles, integrations and the level of testing required.
Web applications are quoted per project after discovery, and maintenance plans start from Rs. 3,000 per month.

Kochi rates are usually well below UAE, UK or North American agency rates for the same scope. As a React JS development company Kochi and Gulf clients compare with local agencies, we fix every quote for the agreed scope and list exactly what is included.

items.q: What does a React JS development company do?
items.a: A React JS development company plans, designs, builds and maintains web interfaces using the React library. At Teknoppy, that covers custom web applications, single page apps, front ends for existing systems, migrations from older code, and ongoing support. You receive tested, documented code.

items.q: How long does a React JS project take?
items.a: A small single page app usually takes 4 to 6 weeks, a mid-size web application 8 to 12 weeks, and a large multi-role platform 3 to 6 months. We confirm the timeline in writing after discovery, before development begins.

items.q: Is React JS good for SEO?
items.a: Yes, when it is built correctly. Search engines can read React pages if content loads quickly. We use clean URLs, proper headings, structured data and fast loading so that your React web pages can be found on Google and cited in AI search answers.

items.q: Why choose React JS for web applications?
items.a: React lets developers build screens from reusable components, so features are faster to add and easier to maintain. It updates only the parts of a page that change, which keeps apps responsive. It also has one of the largest developer communities, so support is easy to find.

items.q: Can I hire React developers for my own team?
items.a: Yes. If you want to hire React developers who work as part of your team, Teknoppy offers monthly plans with dedicated developers. We handle hiring and quality checks.
